items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: a friend of my father's name, Mr. Coochie Martin, he was a guitar player.

ctx.x: It was made out of a seagull box and in the manual training room at school I made a neck and made the pegs to put in it. And, uh, a friend of my father's name, Mr. Coochie Martin, he was a guitar player. Oh yeah.
So he was one of the family of the Martins?
